cinderflask.almanac.aetherglass_cinderfl: Amethyst and an echo shard. The widest vessel, and the only one that lends reach on its own — which is what makes support brewing a late unlock rather than an early one.
cinderflask.almanac.ageing.body: Time turns the wheel and thins the body. A full turn costs some of what is in the flask, and enough turns leave nothing worth drinking.
cinderflask.almanac.ageing.title: Ageing
cinderflask.almanac.amplifier.body: Driven by how concentrated the hot humours are, so it falls away as a brew settles.
cinderflask.almanac.amplifier.title: Strength
cinderflask.almanac.balance.body: How evenly the four are spread. A level brew hands you a spread of weak draughts and no crash at all; a lopsided one hands you a single strong draught and a bill.
cinderflask.almanac.balance.title: Balance
cinderflask.almanac.base.body: Water, or a honey bottle. Nothing else will go into an empty flask until a base has, and until then there is nothing to write into.
cinderflask.almanac.base.title: Opening a Brew
cinderflask.almanac.body.body: Some ingredients add bulk rather than character. Body is how much of the vessel you fill, and filling more of it buys you more doses of something milder.
cinderflask.almanac.body.title: Body
cinderflask.almanac.bound_cinderflask.bo: Iron and honeycomb widen the glass. More room means more doses out of one brew, and the upgrade re-houses the vessel rather than replacing it: mote, seasoning, temper and any name it has earned all move across.
cinderflask.almanac.bramblewine.body: Choleric leaning into melancholic: a wall that bites. Bramble returns a share of what you take to whoever was close enough to land it, though it cannot answer an arrow.
cinderflask.almanac.bramblewine.title: Bramblewine
cinderflask.almanac.capstone.body: Cross enough at once and the dose carries a refusal: the next blow that would finish you leaves you standing on a sliver instead, and then it is spent. No coordinate grants it. It is the one thing in the glass you cannot reach by aiming.
cinderflask.almanac.capstone.title: The Unspent
cinderflask.almanac.choleric.body: Hot and quick. Choleric is force: it drives how hard a brew hits, and it does not last.
cinderflask.almanac.choleric.title: Choleric
cinderflask.almanac.concentration.body: Essence per unit of vessel, and the central trade. Cram a lot into a small flask for a few ferocious doses, or spread it through a large one for many mild ones. Past a point the glass will not hold it at all.
cinderflask.almanac.concentration.title: Concentration
cinderflask.almanac.cork.body: A flask and a plank on a bench. Corking is what starts the clock, so until you do it you can take as long as you like composing one.
cinderflask.almanac.cork.title: Corking
cinderflask.almanac.corrupt.body: Past a certain filth every draught turns. The role is the same and the price is new: Deadman's Vigour still hits harder the emptier you are, and now every swing is paid for in blood. Twelve brews become twenty-four, and the second twelve are not a punishment. They are somewhere else to be.
cinderflask.almanac.corrupt.title: The Other Half
cinderflask.almanac.corruption.body: Filth, bought with reagents or simply waited for. Every full turn of the wheel adds a little, and it is the cheap road into the half of the space nobody aims at on purpose.
cinderflask.almanac.corruption.title: Corruption
cinderflask.almanac.cracking.body: A heavy hit while you are carrying something volatile breaks the glass. A crack breathes off the hot humours first, so a cracked flask drifts colder and slower as it empties, giving long weak doses of something quite unlike what you brewed. Some people keep one on purpose.
cinderflask.almanac.cracking.title: Cracking
cinderflask.almanac.deadmans_draught.bod: Pure choleric, and the berserker's drink. Deadman's Vigour: the emptier you are the harder you swing, and everything hits you harder while it lasts.
cinderflask.almanac.deepdelve.body: Melancholic leaning into sanguine. Deepdelve makes the ground harmless — falls, suffocation, and anything that drops on you.
cinderflask.almanac.deepdelve.title: Deepdelve
cinderflask.almanac.delivery.body: Reach decides who drinks it. A little and it stays in you. More and it bursts outward over whoever is standing with you. Enough and it does not land at all — it hangs where you were, and catches whoever walks in.
cinderflask.almanac.delivery.title: Who It Lands On
cinderflask.almanac.dregs.body: What settles in a flask you drank dry. Open the next brew on them and it starts part-aged, remembering a little of what came before, and coloured by it.
cinderflask.almanac.dregs.title: Dregs
cinderflask.almanac.duration.body: Driven by the share of the brew that is patient rather than the amount of it, which is why duration climbs as strength drops instead of the two rising together.
cinderflask.almanac.duration.title: Duration
cinderflask.almanac.emberflask.body: Choleric carried outward. Emberblood sets alight whatever you hit, and the fire is not yours to fear.
cinderflask.almanac.emberflask.title: Emberflask
cinderflask.almanac.flask.body: Gold and three glass bottles. It holds one brew at a time and gives you one dose a sip. Everything else on this map is something you can do to it.
cinderflask.almanac.flask.title: The Cinderflask
cinderflask.almanac.gravemead.body: Phlegmatic carried outward. Gravebound blunts the undead and knits you back together with every kill.
cinderflask.almanac.gravemead.title: Gravemead
cinderflask.almanac.hint: Drag to pan, scroll to zoom, space to recentre.
Sanguine carried outward. Honeyed mends you and everyone near you; without the reach it would only be a slower Regeneration.
cinderflask.almanac.inflections.body: A brew is not only where it sits. Concentration, evenness, precision, reach, filth, age and volatility each have a point they cross, and so do steeping deep in one humour, the vessel it was made in and the creature its mote came from. Crossing one bends the dose. Crossing several compounds, and the rarest brews are the ones that are several things at once.
cinderflask.almanac.inflections.title: Inflections
cinderflask.almanac.ingredients.body: Everything else you drop in writes into five numbers. Those numbers are the brew. There is no list of recipes to learn, only where you have landed.
cinderflask.almanac.ingredients.title: Writing the Brew
cinderflask.almanac.ironroot_tonic.body: Pure melancholic, and the bulwark's. Ironroot takes a flat amount off every blow, which beats a swarm of small hits where a percentage never would.
cinderflask.almanac.ironroot_tonic.title: Ironroot Tonic
cinderflask.almanac.kelpwine.body: Sanguine leaning into phlegmatic. Kelpsworn stops you needing the surface at all, and softens whatever hits you while you are in water.
cinderflask.almanac.kelpwine.title: Kelpwine
cinderflask.almanac.melancholic.body: Cold and patient. Melancholic is endurance: it drives how long a brew holds, and it is what keeps a volatile one from breaking the glass.
cinderflask.almanac.melancholic.title: Melancholic
cinderflask.almanac.mote.body: Right-click a living thing with an empty flask and a little of it stays in the glass. The mote is the small light in the bottom, and it takes that creature's own colour.
cinderflask.almanac.mote.title: Catching a Mote
cinderflask.almanac.motes_unique.body: Every creature gives a different colour, drawn from the same palette the game uses for its spawn eggs. A flask that caught something unusual looks like nothing else on the server, and it keeps that light through every upgrade and every mending.
cinderflask.almanac.motes_unique.title: Rarer Motes
cinderflask.almanac.names.body: A flask that has held enough brews takes a name from whatever it kept holding. The name follows the vessel through every upgrade and through the fire.
cinderflask.almanac.names.title: Earned Names
cinderflask.almanac.nightcap.body: Pure phlegmatic, and the assassin's. The Unseen Hand pays out when you strike somebody who is not looking at you.
cinderflask.almanac.nightcap.title: Nightcap
cinderflask.almanac.phlegmatic.body: Dull and strange. Phlegmatic is the sour one — weak, long, and it does things none of the other three can.
cinderflask.almanac.phlegmatic.title: Phlegmatic
cinderflask.almanac.quickstep_draught.bo: Phlegmatic leaning into choleric. Quickstep is speed and attack speed, and it only shelters you while you are actually running.
cinderflask.almanac.reach.body: Quintessence sits off the wheel and never rotates. It decides whether a brew happens to you or to the people around you, which is why the four brews that carry it are the four that help somebody else.
cinderflask.almanac.reach.title: Reach
cinderflask.almanac.rebound.body: The crash is the brew running backwards: it takes away exactly what its leading humour lent you. Choleric softens your blows, melancholic takes your wall, sanguine bleeds you, and phlegmatic makes being caught from behind hurt.
cinderflask.almanac.rebound.title: The Rebound
cinderflask.almanac.riposte_cordial.body: Melancholic carried outward. Riposte staggers whoever hit you, however far off they were standing, and your answer inside the window lands heavier.
cinderflask.almanac.sanguine.body: Sweet and vital. Sanguine mends, and it is strong without being sharp.
cinderflask.almanac.sanguine.title: Sanguine
cinderflask.almanac.sap_sworn_mead.body: Pure sanguine, and the reaver's. Sapsworn puts a share of whatever you take out of somebody back into you.
cinderflask.almanac.sap_sworn_mead.title: Sap-Sworn Mead
cinderflask.almanac.sinter.body: Pack a cracked flask in sand and fire it in a furnace. What comes out is the same vessel, with its mote, its seasoning, its temper and its name all intact — repairing an heirloom should not cost you the heirloom.
cinderflask.almanac.sinter.title: Sintering
cinderflask.almanac.sip.body: One dose a sip, quick enough to do mid-fight. What you get depends on where the brew sits, not on what went into it.
cinderflask.almanac.sip.title: Drinking
cinderflask.almanac.solera.body: Pour a working brew into a sealed one and both the vector and the age blend by dose. Decay outruns anything brewed fresh, so a deep phase at full strength is only reachable by keeping one running.
cinderflask.almanac.solera.title: Solera
cinderflask.almanac.sump.body: What a brew becomes when it is left far too long, or crammed past what the glass can hold. It is not a drink. It remembers what it used to be, which is what makes it a way into the corrupt half rather than simply rubbish.
cinderflask.almanac.sump.title: Sump
cinderflask.almanac.temper.body: Hold a flask against the right block and the glass takes a temper. A temper changes only how fast what is inside turns — never what it turns into.
cinderflask.almanac.temper.title: Tempering
cinderflask.almanac.wheel.body: A sealed brew turns one step every half day. Choleric settles into melancholic, melancholic mellows into sanguine, sanguine sours into phlegmatic, and phlegmatic comes back round to choleric. Four steps is a full turn. It is worked out from the moment you corked it, so a flask ages just as well forgotten in a chest.
cinderflask.almanac.wheel.title: The Wheel
cinderflask.almanac.witch_iron_cinderfla: An iron block and a wither rose. Wider again, and the first vessel that will hold a brew concentrated enough to be genuinely dangerous.
cinderflask.impression.choleric: It smells sharp, and it is not patient.
cinderflask.impression.melancholic: Cold, and it sits heavy in the glass.
cinderflask.impression.phlegmatic: Sour, and it does not smell like much at all.
cinderflask.impression.sanguine: Sweet. Something in it wants you well.
cinderflask.info.ageing: A sealed brew turns one step round the wheel every half day, and it does it in a chest as readily as in your hand. Choleric settles into melancholic, melancholic mellows into sanguine, sanguine sours into phlegmatic, and phlegmatic comes back round to choleric. Four steps is a full turn, and a full turn costs the brew some of its body.
cinderflask.info.cracked: A heavy hit while you are carrying something volatile cracks the flask. A crack breathes off the hot humours first, so a cracked flask drifts colder and slower as it empties — long weak doses of something quite unlike what you brewed. Some people keep one on purpose.
cinderflask.info.dregs: What settles in a flask you drank dry. Open the next brew on it and that brew starts part-aged, remembering some of what came before.
cinderflask.info.sump: What a brew becomes when it is left far too long, or crammed past what the vessel can hold. It is not a drink. It is the cheap way into the corrupt half of the wheel.
cinderflask.message.uncorked: It is not corked. Nothing is finished.
cinderflask.tooltip.almanac: A map of everything the glass can do.
cinderflask.tooltip.dregs: The last of something. It remembers a little.
cinderflask.tooltip.empty: Empty. Something ought to go in it.
cinderflask.tooltip.no_mote: No mote. Offer it something living.
cinderflask.tooltip.sinter: Packed in sand. Fire it to mend it.
cinderflask.tooltip.sump: Thick, and it moves when you are not looking.
cinderflask.vessel.almanac: Writes a book against a flask. The flask is handed straight back.
cinderflask.vessel.carries: The mote, the seasoning, the temper and the name all survive.
cinderflask.vessel.cork: Seals a working brew. This is what starts its clock.
cinderflask.vessel.sinter: Packs a cracked flask in sand. Fire it in a furnace to mend it.
cinderflask.vessel.solera: Pours a working brew into a sealed one. Strength and age both blend by dose.
cinderflask.vessel.upgrade: Re-houses the brew in a wider vessel.
